post_ship_review.summary: 8 findings verified (6 CONFIRMED + 1 NEEDS_NUANCE + 1 REFUTED). 7 fixes precisely applied to the source MD; the REFUTED finding (SDS U-Net Jacobian described as a 'second-order' term) was left untouched — DreamFusion's own text ties that Jacobian to the Hessian of the log-density, so the tutorial's phrasing is an accurate paraphrase, not an error.
fixes: §0/§3/interview-Q4: Instant-NGP speedup '5+ OOM' softened to 'roughly 4+ orders of magnitude' — the tutorial's own worked example (1-2 days vs 5s) only nets ~4.2-4.5 orders of magnitude, not 5+ (CONFIRMED, 3 occurrences)

§3.3/interview-Q13: hash-collision point 3 corrected — empty-region sample points with non-zero density DO get a nonzero volume-rendering gradient (proportional to delta_i * e^(-sigma_i*delta_i), pushing sigma toward 0); they only stop getting gradient once sigma decays and the occupancy grid skips them, not 'from the start' (CONFIRMED, 2 occurrences)

§4.5 table + code: 3DGS clone/split mechanism was reversed — clone duplicates in place (new_xyz = original xyz, no gradient offset) and split is the one that samples a new position (torch.normal with scale as std + rotation, then scale / 1.6); fixed table row wording, code comments, the clone_at() call (dropped the fabricated offset=grad_dir argument and grad_dir field), and the split_at() comment (CONFIRMED)
§4.5 table: opacity-reset value corrected 0.005 -> 0.01; 0.005 is the separate min_opacity prune threshold already used correctly elsewhere in the same code block, not the reset value (CONFIRMED)

§5.2: DMTet 'geometry fully differentiable' claim qualified — differentiable within a fixed-topology region, but not differentiable at the measure-zero instant a vertex SDF crosses zero and switches the tetrahedron's marching-tetrahedra look-up case (topology change), analogous to the ReLU kink at 0 (NEEDS_NUANCE, severity downgraded from P0 to P1)

§6.7/interview-Q15/Q25: VSD's auxiliary score network epsilon_psi was mischaracterized as merely a zero-mean 'variance-reduction baseline (isomorphic to an RL actor-critic value baseline)'; corrected to: epsilon_psi is the necessary term corresponding to the q-distribution's own score arising from differentiating the KL objective w.r.t. theta — dropping it changes the expected gradient direction (degrading distribution-matching back to SDS's mode-seeking), unlike a true RL baseline which only reduces variance without changing the expected gradient (CONFIRMED, 4 occurrences)

§1 comparison table: 3DGS 'downstream fit' cell claimed 'easy to plug into PBR/IsaacSim/URDF', contradicting the tutorial's own §10.2 recommendation (convert to mesh first via Trellis/Hunyuan3D-2 before IsaacSim/MuJoCo); cell rewritten to require mesh conversion first, consistent with §10.2 (CONFIRMED)

§7.1/interview-Q16: Zero-1-to-3++'s 6 fixed anchor views were described as a zenith/pole layout ('north-pole view + 4 eye-level views + a top view'); corrected to the paper's actual configuration — azimuth uniformly spaced every 60 degrees around 30/90/150/210/270/330 degrees, elevation alternating between -10 and 20 degrees (interleaved elevation + uniform azimuth) (CONFIRMED)
